display.en-US: Dimli the Dwarf — Join the Game
display.zh-TW: 迪姆利・矮人—加入賭局

rulesSummary.en-US: During your Action phase, start a gambling round and have all players ante. During an active gambling round, take control unless the current Winning-Hand restriction forbids a Gambling card.
rulesSummary.zh-TW: 在出牌行動階段開始一輪賭博並讓所有玩家投入；賭博已進行中時可取得主導權，但若目前受到「好牌」類限制則一般賭博牌不能奪權。

display.en-US: Dimli the Dwarf — Raise the Stakes
display.zh-TW: 迪姆利・矮人—加注

rulesSummary.en-US: Take control and require each player still in the round to ante 1 additional Gold. If the player causing the ante cannot make the required ante under the governing rules, nobody is required to ante.
rulesSummary.zh-TW: 取得主導權，並要求仍在本輪賭博中的每位玩家再投入 1 金幣；若發動此效果的玩家依規則無法完成該次投入，則其他玩家也不必投入。

display.zh-TW: 迪姆利・矮人—好牌在手

rulesSummary.en-US: Take control. Until a Cheating card takes control, an ordinary Gambling card cannot take control.
rulesSummary.zh-TW: 取得主導權；直到有作弊牌奪權前，一般賭博牌不能再取得主導權。

display.en-US: Dimli the Dwarf — The House Takes the Pot
display.zh-TW: 迪姆利・矮人—酒館收走賭池

rulesSummary.en-US: During an active Round of Gambling, including after you have left, end the Round immediately and send all anted Gold to the Inn. Not legal after the Round ended, in response to an ante-causing card, or in response to a card that itself ends the Round. May respond to forced leave, including in a two-player Round; may not respond to an anti-cheat win card or act after the final pass.
rulesSummary.zh-TW: 在賭局進行中，即使你已離開本輪，仍可立即結束本輪並將所有已投入的金幣交給酒館。本輪已結束、正在回應要求投入金幣的牌、或正在回應本身會結束本輪的牌時不可使用。可回應強制離場，即使本輪只剩兩名參與者；不能回應抓作弊並獲勝的牌，也不能在最後一人跳過後使用。

display.en-US: Dimli the Dwarf — Run It Back
display.zh-TW: 迪姆利・矮人—再賭一局

rulesSummary.en-US: When another player wins a Round, before its pot is paid, restart that Round with all anted Gold retained. Only players who have not already left remain and each must ante 1 additional Gold. You are currently winning; continue to your left. Cannot be played after you have left or if “Um… I know you think you won, but…” was played. This is the specific printed exclusion, not a prohibition on every winner-changing effect.
rulesSummary.zh-TW: 當另一名玩家贏得本輪、賭池尚未支付時，重新開始本輪並保留所有已投入的金幣。只有尚未離場的玩家留下，每人必須再投入 1 金幣。你成為目前領先者，接著從你左手邊繼續。若你已離場，或「Um… I know you think you won, but…」已被打出，則不能使用。這是原牌明列的特定限制，不是禁止所有改變勝者的效果。

display.en-US: Dimli the Dwarf — Use the Inn's Gold
display.zh-TW: 迪姆利・矮人—用酒館的金幣

rulesSummary.en-US: Before your current Gold loss resolves, use Inn Gold for the whole current payment, ante, or Gold taken by another player. Your Stash loses no Gold; the original recipient or pot receives the Gold, and an ante is satisfied. Paying the Inn has no net Inn transfer and gives you no Gold. May cover costs caused by your own card. Covers only this loss instance, not future separate payments; explicit source-specific payment restrictions still apply.
rulesSummary.zh-TW: 在你目前這次金幣損失結算前，改用酒館的金幣支付整筆款項、投入賭池，或交給原本要拿走金幣的玩家。你的金幣不減少，原收款者或賭池取得金幣，投入義務仍算完成。若原收款方就是酒館，酒館沒有淨移轉，你也不取得金幣。自己打出的牌造成的費用也可使用。只處理目前這一次損失，不涵蓋後續獨立付款；原來源明列的付款限制仍適用。

display.en-US: Dimli the Dwarf — Sit This One Out
display.zh-TW: 迪姆利・矮人—這局先退出

rulesSummary.en-US: Before your current required ante is collected, cancel that ante and leave the current Round. Earlier anted Gold remains in the pot. Applies to initial and later antes while participating, unless that source expressly forbids responses. Other participants still ante; after leaving, no further participant antes apply and Gambling/Cheating are barred for this Round, while otherwise-legal Sometimes/Anytime remain available.
rulesSummary.zh-TW: 在收取你目前必須投入的金幣前，免除這一次投入並離開本輪賭博。先前已投入的金幣仍留在賭池。仍參與賭博時，初次與後續投入都可回應，除非原來源明列禁止回應。其他參與者仍須投入；離場後不再承擔本輪參與者的投入，也不能使用賭博或作弊牌，但仍可使用其他合法的有時或隨時牌。

display.en-US: Dimli the Dwarf — Leave or Refuse the Drink
display.zh-TW: 迪姆利・矮人—退出或擋酒

rulesSummary.en-US: When your current ante is required while you still participate, cancel that payment and leave the Round. Earlier Gold stays in the pot; other participants still ante. Initial and later antes qualify unless the source expressly forbids responses. After leaving, no further participant antes or Gambling/Cheating cards this Round; otherwise-legal Sometimes/Anytime remain. OR Ignore the current Drink affecting you, after all Chasers are revealed and before resolution. Ignore the whole Drink, not a Drink Event or an unaffected player’s Drink. The Drink branch does not leave the Round.
rulesSummary.zh-TW: 仍參與賭博且目前必須投入金幣時，免除本次投入並離開本輪；先前投入留在賭池，其他參與者仍須投入。初次與後續投入均可回應，除非來源明列禁止回應。離場後不再承擔參與者的投入，也不能打出賭博或作弊牌，但仍可打出其他合法的 Sometimes／Anytime 牌。或在全部續杯揭露後、結算前，忽略目前影響你的整杯飲料；不能忽略飲酒事件或未影響你的他人飲料。飲料分支不會使你離開賭局。
